component.name: DreamStation
component.summary: Play Sega Dreamcast, Naomi and Atomiswave games

description.p: DreamStation is a desktop emulator for the Sega Dreamcast and the Naomi and Atomiswave arcade boards, built on the Flycast emulation engine with a GTK 4 interface: a game library with covers, per-game settings, save states, VMU tools, shader chains and online play.
You need your own console BIOS and your own games. None are included.
